name: Carebun Interactive
eyebrow: Books you read with your hands
headline: Learn it
by moving it
tagline: Interactive books, from novice to ninja
tagline_long: Textbooks written in plain language, where every number can be moved and every idea can be tried on the page. Pick a book and start at chapter one.
principles: Plain words. Every term is explained the first time it appears, with one analogy that runs through the whole book.
Numbers you can move. Every calculation is shown step by step, and a slider sits next to it.
Real output. Experiments are run, and what they printed is shown, including what went wrong.
Recall beats re-reading. Every chapter ends with questions and folded answers.
Anyone can write one. A book is a folder of chapters. The guide is itself a book on this shelf.
credits: Built with the Carebun Interactive engine: plain HTML chapters, a small widget runtime, no framework.
